operations.prompt: A single original stylized dungeon slime creature for a fantasy game. One compact rounded moss-green jelly blob resting on its flat soft underside, two simple clearly visible small dark eyes on the front, smooth clean continuous body. Entire creature isolated with no platform or scenery. Neutral rest pose, roughly 0.9 meters wide and 0.65 meters tall. Slight translucent-looking green surface but a solid complete mesh. No limbs, no weapons, no crown, no spikes, no rocks, no ground, no text or logo. Restrained dark fantasy game palette, reusable base body for later ice and king variants.
